user_requirements: Review REPORT.md — Absolute Security Group's board-facing Quarterly Report & Value/ROI Review of the HOTC (Heart of the City) CBD Safety Team, for the HOTC leadership/board. SOURCE_DATA.txt has the underlying monthly data. This must be BOARD-PRESENTABLE, VALUE-LED and ROI-focused, while every number is defensible (a prior ASG document was queried by HOTC over one mis-attributed statistic, so unsupported claims are the top risk). Your job: (1) VERIFY every figure against SOURCE_DATA.txt — the quarter totals (673 calls, 667 incidents), the month values, the −21% post-cut drop, the +52% pilot lift, the +136 calls/+136 incidents pilot uplift, the ~$276 and ~$300 per-call figures, June being the record incident month — flag anything that does not reproduce or is internally inconsistent. (2) Pressure-test the ROI/value framing for honesty: is 'funding converts to output at a predictable near-linear rate' actually supported (pilot ~$300 vs core ~$276)? Is the 'unmet demand' claim defensible? Flag any ROI statement that overstates. (3) Check the funding attribution ($800k→$690k, cut Apr/May 2025) is presented as fact carefully — HOTC knows its own budget, but ensure nothing implies causation beyond what the data shows. (4) Check the July-2025 estimate and the 'detail incidents only from Mar 2026' limitation are disclosed, not hidden. (5) Assess board tone — confident, value-led, not defensive, not over-promotional; is the case for funding made without sounding self-serving? (6) List concrete corrections with severity CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/PASS, exact current text and exact replacement text. Do NOT rewrite wholesale — produce the findings list.
acquirer_context: Audience: Heart of the City leadership and board (Auckland CBD business association) who fund the safety programme. The report both reports the quarter and makes the case to protect/grow funding, so it must be persuasive yet scrupulously honest — a self-serving overstatement would damage the relationship. ASG must not invent Council/third-party statistics or imply ROI the data cannot support.
